name: Lee County, MS
findings: Lee County has 187 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do health care organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 1 social and fraternal organization here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
